## What this change does
(Plain words. One or two sentences.)

## Risk level
- [ ] **Low:** wording, colors, a small fix in one page. One reviewer.
- [ ] **Medium:** a new feature or a change in how a page works. A written plan was approved first.
- [ ] **High:** access, sign-in, the review chain, deleting or correcting data, payments, backups, alerts, scheduled jobs, deployment. Plan and design approved first, tested on a copy, a rollback plan written.

Link to the approved plan or request (required for Medium and High): 

## Checks
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] I read the whole change, not only the summary
- [ ] No secrets, names, emails or personal data in the change
- [ ] User guide, manual, quick start and in-app Help updated if users can see the change
- [ ] Change log entry written

## How to go back if it goes wrong
(For example: roll back the deploy with `npx wrangler rollback`.)

## When it will be deployed
(Not between 07:00 and 17:00 East Africa Time during field work unless it fixes a live problem.)
